title: Buddha's First Sermon
description: Gautama Buddha delivers his first sermon at Sarnath.

title: Ashoka Builds Sarnath Monuments
description: Emperor Ashoka constructs stupas and monasteries at Sarnath.

title: Kashi Vishwanath Destroyed
description: Qutb-ud-din Aibak destroys the earlier Kashi Vishwanath Temple.

title: Kashi Vishwanath Rebuilt
description: Raja Man Singh rebuilds the temple.

title: Temple Destroyed by Aurangzeb
description: Mughal Emperor Aurangzeb destroys the temple and builds Gyanvapi Mosque.

title: Dashashwamedh Ghat Rebuilt
description: Peshwa Balaji Baji Rao rebuilds the ghat.

title: Ramnagar Fort Built
description: Kashi Naresh Balwant Singh builds Ramnagar Fort.

title: Current Kashi Vishwanath Temple Built
description: Ahilyabai Holkar constructs the current temple.

title: Gold Donated for Temple Dome
description: Maharaja Ranjit Singh donates gold for the Kashi Vishwanath dome.

title: Bharat Mata Mandir Inaugurated
description: Mahatma Gandhi inaugurates Bharat Mata Mandir.

title: Kashi Vishwanath Corridor
description: The Kashi Vishwanath Corridor is inaugurated, transforming access to the temple.
